Foxhaven Asset Management LP Stake in Facebook (FB) Has Decreased by $26.61 Million; Builders Firstsource (BLDR) Holding Has Increased by Impala Asset Management Llc
May 17, 2018 - By Henry Gaston
Michael Pausic decreased its stake in Facebook Inc (FB) by 29.5% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Foxhaven Asset Management Lp sold 151,181 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.10% with the market. The hedge fund run by Michael Pausic held 361,378 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $63.77M, down from 512,559 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Foxhaven Asset Management Lp who had been investing in Facebook Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $530.79B market cap company. The stock increased 0.09% or $0.17 during the last trading session, reaching $183.37. About 8.53M shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 8.48% since May 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.07% the S&P500.
Robert Bishop increased its stake in Builders Firstsource Inc (BLDR) by 30.71% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Impala Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Builders Firstsource Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $2.17B market cap company. (NASDAQ:BLDR) has risen 35.87% since May 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 24.32% the S&P500.
